component.name: DA Vibe Manager
component.summary: Add the features you wish your apps had, and keep those apps up to date

description.p: Tell it what you wish an open-source app could do, and an AI builds you a version that does it. Then it keeps that app up to date like any other software: when the project releases a new version, your changes are carried over and rebuilt, at a time you choose.

When an app it built doesn't work on your computer, it finds out why, asking before every step, and fixes the build so it works there too. Apps can be shared with other people who use it, and a version fixed on one computer goes back to the others as an update. It works in a sealed sandbox: it can't see your files, and nothing runs on your computer until you say so.
